known_limitations.detail: API18_1/API22_1/API216 and API21_1 provide meet 1 and raw meet 3 only. Meet 3 remains the source's Yeongnam region label and cannot be split into Busan meet 3 and Yeongcheon meet 4; no meet 4 rows are present in these datasets.
known_limitations.evidence: The source contracts and READMEs define meets 1/3 and prohibit physical-venue inference; API78 separately has meets 1/3/4.

known_limitations.detail: The source captures do not establish historical pre-race availability. Every row retains a retrospective/unverified status. The 2017+ row counts are reported separately; passing this QA does not approve feature use.

Identical repeated source payloads, especially the 24-row/8-group swim repeat set, remain observations and must not be interpreted as additional real workouts without a separate aggregation rule. API22 occurrence order is anonymous storage order, not an event ID or chronology.

Horse, trainer and owner links use exact source official IDs. Names are not join keys; current profile trainer/owner values are not backfilled into historical rows. Unmatched and missing source IDs remain separate exceptions.

The backup contains confirmed_runners_entity_reviewed_before_role_review and trial_participants_entity_reviewed_before_role_review outside the manifest object-count map. The coordinator confirmed these two helper views are intentional unregistered intermediates; all other declared object names match.

roster_relationship_rule_counts.relationship_rule: event IDs are event-level only; current profile trainer/owner values are not backfilled
